title: Spectral Photogrammetry Protocol
author: Aurore Mathys
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zzgf73w
materials: Separate the wavelengths in different folders.

steps.title: Prepare Specimen and Calibration
steps.instruction: Place the specimen at the center of the turntable along with scales, a photogrammetry marker, and an MSI calibration card (CHSOS).

steps.title: Configure Exposure and Hardware
steps.instruction: Set up the lamp and camera distance, placing the camera at approximately 30°. Configure the correct exposure for each wavelength.

substeps.instruction: Verify exposure in spectrashoot using the MSI calibration card
Adjust exposure until the specimen is correctly lit

steps.title: Capture Images at 30° Angle
steps.instruction: Capture images in raw format for one specimen position and repeat for a complete rotation of the turntable in 10° increments.

substeps.instruction: Capture images at all 15 wavelengths plus white light
Add UV-pass filter and capture pictures in UV wavelengths (UVR)
Add UV-cut off filter and capture pictures for each UV wavelength (UVF)
Rotate turntable by 10° and repeat capture sequence until a full rotation is complete

steps.title: Capture Images at 60° Angle
steps.instruction: Move the camera to an angle of 60° at approximately the same distance as the previous setup and repeat the full rotation capture operation.

steps.title: Perform Additional Views
steps.instruction: If necessary, turn the specimen and repeat the rotation/view process as many times as required.

steps.title: Import Data into Agisoft Photoscan
steps.instruction: Open Agisoft Photoscan, create a chunk for each wavelength (renaming them accordingly), and import the pictures.

steps.title: Process 3D Models
steps.instruction: Use the batch process workflow to generate models and verify reliability.

substeps.instruction: Add 'align pictures' (highest), 'build dense cloud' (high), and 'build mesh' (high)
Repeat the processing 3 times to ensure results are reliable

steps.title: Export Models
steps.instruction: If the results are reliable, export the models as .stl files for surface analysis.
